focus.title: 美国扩大对华半导体设备出口管制，欧盟拟对中国电动汽车加征关税，全球供应链重构加速
focus.summary: 本周，美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）进一步收紧对华半导体设备出口管制，新增数十家中国实体至“实体清单”，限制其获取美国技术及设备。同时，欧盟委员会公布对中国产电动汽车的反补贴调查初步裁定，拟加征17%至36%的临时关税，引发中欧经贸关系紧张。此外，日本与荷兰协同美国强化对华先进制程设备出口限制。上述动向表明，西方国家正加速构建“去风险”贸易壁垒，中国出海企业面临技术获取与市场准入双重挑战，需加快供应链多元化布局。
focus.source: 来源：美国商务部BIS、欧盟委员会 · 本周
focus.title_en: US Expands Semiconductor Equipment Export Controls on China, EU Proposes Tariffs on Chinese EVs, Accelerating Global Supply Chain Restructuring
focus.summary_en: This week, the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) further tightened export controls on semiconductor equipment to China, adding dozens of Chinese entities to the Entity List, restricting their access to U.S. technology and equipment. Meanwhile, the European Commission announced preliminary findings of its anti-subsidy investigation into Chinese electric vehicles, proposing provisional tariffs ranging from 17% to 36%, escalating trade tensions. Japan and the Netherlands also coordinated with the U.S. to strengthen restrictions on advanced process equipment exports. These developments indicate that Western countries are accelerating the construction of 'de-risking' trade barriers, posing dual challenges of technology acquisition and market access for Chinese companies going global, necessitating accelerated supply chain diversification.
focus.source_en: Source: U.S. BIS, European Commission · this week

case.title: 美国法院批准中国某科技公司就华为禁令提起的诉讼部分程序，凸显美国出口管制司法审查趋势
case.summary: 本周，美国哥伦比亚特区联邦地区法院裁定，允许中国某科技公司就美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）基于国家安全理由将其列入“受制裁设备清单”的决定提起部分诉讼程序。法院认为，原告有充分理由质疑该决定缺乏正当程序。该案被视为美国出口管制与国家安全措施司法审查的重要风向标，提示出海企业应重视利用美国国内司法程序挑战不合理的行政决定，并保留完整合规记录以支持诉讼。
case.source: 来源：美国哥伦比亚特区联邦地区法院 · 本周
case.title_en: U.S. Court Allows Partial Lawsuit by Chinese Tech Company Over FCC Ban, Indicating Judicial Review Trend on Export Controls
case.summary_en: This week, the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia ruled to allow a Chinese technology company to proceed with partial litigation against the Federal Communications Commission's (FCC) decision to include it on the 'covered equipment list' based on national security concerns. The court found that the plaintiff had sufficiently challenged the lack of due process. This case is seen as a bellwether for judicial review of U.S. export controls and national security measures, reminding Chinese companies to utilize U.S. judicial procedures to challenge unreasonable administrative decisions and maintain comprehensive compliance records to support litigation.
case.source_en: Source: U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia · this week

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区发布跨境数据流动“白名单”管理办法，简化企业数据出境合规流程
policy.summary: 本周，广东省互联网信息办公室联合港澳相关部门发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动“白名单”管理办法（试行）》，明确将金融、医疗、交通等领域常见商业数据纳入“白名单”，企业向指定区域传输此类数据时无需逐案申报安全评估，仅需完成备案。该办法大幅降低企业数据出境合规成本，是内地与港澳规则衔接的重要突破。同时，深圳前海推出跨境法律合作新机制，允许港澳律师在前海特定律所提供中国法律咨询（非诉讼），进一步便利跨境法律服务。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 本周
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Issues 'Whitelist' Measures for Cross-Border Data Flows, Simplifying Data Export Compliance
policy.summary_en: This week, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province, in coordination with Hong Kong and Macau authorities, released the 'Measures for the Administration of the Cross-Border Data Flow Whitelist in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Trial)', which includes common commercial data in sectors such as finance, healthcare, and transportation in a 'whitelist'. Enterprises transferring such data to designated regions are exempt from case-by-case security assessments and only need to complete filing. This significantly reduces compliance costs for data export and represents a key breakthrough in aligning rules between the mainland and Hong Kong/Macau. Additionally, Shenzhen Qianhai introduced a new mechanism for cross-border legal cooperation, allowing Hong Kong and Macau lawyers to provide Chinese legal advice (non-litigation) in designated Qianhai law firms, further facilitating cross-border legal services.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：出海企业应建立“双循环”合规体系，动态应对制裁与关税风险
analysis.summary: 本周国际经贸环境呈现“多线承压”特征：美国出口管制实体清单持续扩容，欧盟反补贴关税箭在弦上，而中国则通过粤港澳大湾区数据流动白名单等政策释放开放信号。秦林蒿律师建议出海企业：第一，构建“中国法+目标国法”双合规体系，尤其在半导体、新能源等高敏感行业，需同步追踪中国出口管制合规要求及目标国制裁法规；第二，针对欧盟关税风险，提前完成原产地规则合规审查，考虑在欧盟境内设立组装厂或寻找替代供应商；第三，善用粤港澳大湾区政策红利，将数据跨境传输、法律争议解决等环节优先落地大湾区，降低合规成本。下周重点关注：美国对华半导体管制最终规则是否扩大至AI芯片，以及欧盟关税投票结果。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 本周
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: Build a 'Dual-Cycle' Compliance System to Dynamically Address Sanctions and Tariff Risks
analysis.summary_en: This week's international trade environment features 'multi-front pressure': the U.S. export control entity list continues to expand, EU anti-subsidy tariffs are imminent, while China signals openness through the Greater Bay Area data flow whitelist. Attorney Qin Linhao recommends that companies going global: first, establish a 'dual-compliance' system covering both Chinese law and target country law, especially in high-sensitivity sectors like semiconductors and new energy, tracking both China's export control requirements and target countries' sanctions regulations; second, for EU tariff risks, conduct compliance reviews on rules of origin in advance and consider setting up assembly plants in the EU or seeking alternative suppliers; third, leverage the Greater Bay Area policy dividends by prioritizing data cross-border transfer and legal dispute resolution in the region to reduce compliance costs. Next week's focus: whether the final U.S. rule on semiconductor controls will expand to AI chips, and the outcome of the EU tariff vote.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · this week
